titel: iPhone Ultra and iPhone 18 Pro rumors

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts

einzeiler: Details on upcoming iPhone Ultra and iPhone 18 Pro specs, pricing, and ongoing lawsuits.
kurzfassung: Apple allows Mac App Store developers to drop Intel support as macOS 27 approaches. Mark Gurman shares new details regarding the upcoming foldable iPhone Ultra, including design and multitasking features. Meanwhile, component costs may drive up retail prices for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra.
stichpunkte: macOS apps on the App Store can now drop Intel support
macOS 27 drops Intel support entirely alongside Rosetta 2 discontinuation
iPhone Ultra expected to feature a 5.5-inch cover and 7.8-inch inner display
Foldable phone hinge uses a durable liquid metal design
Multitasking on the foldable will include drag-and-drop support across devices
iPhone 18 Pro memory costs expected to rise significantly
iPhone Ultra pricing estimated to start at $2299
OpenAI responds to Apple's trade secret lawsuit over former employee data

kapitel.titel: Intel Support on Mac App Store

clips.hook: Dropping Intel support on the Mac App Store
clips.text: Developers can now remove Intel architecture binaries to reduce download sizes and simplify software maintenance, coinciding with the upcoming software release.

clips.hook: Display dimensions of the foldable device
clips.text: The hardware includes an exterior screen for basic interactions and a much larger interior screen revealed by unfolding the device.
Component expenditures for storage hardware are projected to quadruple compared to the previous year, putting pressure on overall profit margins.
